CHANGELOG updated in IDUNA_PRO: feat(community-tools): real Target resumes -- bespoke, tailored variants per opportunity. Work/Education/Skill/Award get stable IDs; new Target{IncludedXIDs, SummaryOverride, LabelOverride} + Resolve(master, target). New /targets, /targets/{id}/resolved, /targets/{id}/verify endpoints -- verify runs against the resolved view, not the master. New migration (sibling targets JSON column). 17 new tests. Full suite green. Apple #18733. (sess-20260905-0720-ec33e7c5)

⚓ ☃
